profiles.description: Each condition receives the same case package, model, reasoning request, verification interface, and one review turn.
Reviewer conditions may use their declared additional independent-review turns; self-review receives one deliberate second-pass instruction and every extra turn is reported.

reviewBoundary.sharedInput: one content-addressed conclusion-free artifact, obligation, verification-interface, and authority envelope
reviewBoundary.joinTiming: only after both role invocations reach terminal output
reviewBoundary.joinOperation: ordered requirements-then-quality finding-reference union without semantic deduplication

scenarios.approvedObligation: Concurrent writers must publish a complete record atomically without lost updates.
scenarios.artifact: The save function checks whether output.json exists, writes directly to output.json, and then reports success. Two workers can call it concurrently.
scenarios.verificationEvidence: The focused test covers one writer and passes.
scenarios.expectedFinding: the check-then-direct-write sequence is non-atomic and can lose or expose a partial concurrent update

scenarios.approvedObligation: Every output write must remain beneath the approved root and reject symlink traversal before mutation.
scenarios.artifact: The writer resolves root plus a user path and checks the lexical prefix. It then calls writeFile on the path without inspecting existing path components.
scenarios.verificationEvidence: Traversal segments using dot-dot are rejected; no symlink case was run.
scenarios.expectedFinding: a symlink below the lexically contained path can redirect the write outside the approved root

scenarios.approvedObligation: All entry points must enforce the same allowlist and fail closed when an action is not allowed.
scenarios.artifact: The CLI and hook each contain copied allowlist logic. The CLI accepts read and verify; the hook accepts read, verify, and deploy. There is no shared policy function.
scenarios.verificationEvidence: Unit tests independently assert the currently copied lists and pass.
scenarios.expectedFinding: duplicated policy has already drifted so one entry point authorizes deploy contrary to the shared obligation

scenarios.approvedObligation: Publish a complete record atomically, preserve the previous record on failure, and reject symlink output paths.
scenarios.artifact: The writer opens an anchored no-follow root, creates a unique sibling file with exclusive creation, writes and fsyncs it, atomically renames it, fsyncs the directory, and cleans only its staging file on failure.
scenarios.verificationEvidence: Focused tests cover concurrent writers, injected write failure, existing symlink targets, and retry cleanup; all pass after the implementation digest.

scenarios.approvedObligation: Return the supplied immutable identifier unchanged.
scenarios.artifact: A one-line pure function returns its identifier argument.

classification.truePositive: A verdict identifies the planted causal defect for a defect-bearing scenario.
classification.falseNegative: A verdict reports no material defect for a defect-bearing scenario.
classification.falsePositive: A verdict reports a material defect for a defect-free control.
classification.trueNegative: A verdict reports no material defect for a defect-free control.
classification.severityCalibration: The safety escape is critical; implementation and maintainability defects are important.

decisionRule: Create a quality reviewer body and retain a multi-reviewer topology only if incumbent self-review leaves a measurable gap and a matched treatment closes it within the frozen effectiveness, agreement, repair, regression, attrition, and resource gates.
exclusions: The formative probes do not establish sealed confirmation performance.
Requested model identity is recorded; independent served-model attestation is unavailable in print mode.
A topology whose prerequisite role was not selected cannot be treated as an earned paired release dependency.
